requests.reply: {"translations": ["In the early morning, the clouds and mist outside the mountain gate have not yet dispersed.", "Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough spirit stones?"]}
{"translations": ["I brought three bags, all the best from the back mountain."]}
{"translations": ["The barrier cracked another seam last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep a wink."]}

{"translations": ["Before the words had even faded, Moqi Jing came racing up from the foot of the mountain.", "Panting, he said that a young woman was lying by the roadside at the foot of the mountain."]}
{"translations": ["Lift him up quickly. Ruoshui, go fetch the healing elixir."]}
{"translations": ["Wan Qi Jing rushed into the great hall carrying an unconscious woman on his back, the iron plate at his waist engraved with: Qiu Shuang."]}
{"translations": ["The wound isn't serious, it's just that spiritual energy is depleted. Feeding him one Spirit-Restoring Pill should be enough."]}
{"translations": ["Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin is calling you to the barrier over there. Senior Brother Moqi and I are here.", "Good. Miss Qiu has woken up, so come get me right away."]}
{"translations": ["Wan Qi Jing scratched his head, then turned and ran toward the foot of the mountain."]}
{"translations": ["Jie Xuan stood at the palace gate, his sword still sheathed, yet the lamplight dimmed for an instant."]}
{"translations": ["Elder Qin, it has been a while. I have come on the order of the Pavilion Master to collect three tenths of the spirit stones."]}

{"translations": ["Sanzheng? The spirit stones were painstakingly saved up by the sect. When would it ever be an outsider's turn to take them?", "The barrier has already cracked, so the spirit stones are not safe in your hands. I will return in three days."]}
{"translations": ["Jie Xuan let out a cold laugh, turned around, and walked away without looking back."]}
{"translations": ["When I say three days, it's three days; I never go back on my word."]}
{"translations": ["Elder Qin stroked his beard and glanced at Chou Shuang, who lay asleep on the couch."]}
{"translations": ["Elder, let me go guard the barrier. Miss Chou has Yuechuan looking after her, so I can be spared.", "Finally, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve."]}
{"translations": ["This is the Formation Eye Token. Only by holding it can you truly hold your Dao."]}
{"translations": ["Le Chuan tucked the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's arms and added a few more words of instruction in a low voice."]}
{"translations": ["At the mountain gate, Wan Qi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.", "Thank you, Senior Brother Wan Qi. Miss Qiu has woken up, so please pass on my thanks to her."]}
{"translations": ["Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation-eye token close to his body."]}
{"translations": ["In the palace hall, Chou Shuang slowly opened her eyes."]}
{"translations": ["Glad you're awake. You were unconscious for a whole day, so don't move around carelessly ▼"]}
{"translations": ["Qiu Shuang struggled to sit up and gazed at the cracked sky outside the window.", "Unbeknownst to anyone, the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal."]}

translations.1: In the early morning, the clouds and mist outside the mountain gate have not yet dispersed.
translations.10: Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin is calling you to the barrier over there. Senior Brother Moqi and I are here.
translations.11: Good. Miss Qiu has woken up, so come get me right away.
translations.12: Wan Qi Jing scratched his head, then turned and ran toward the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: Jie Xuan stood at the palace gate, his sword still sheathed, yet the lamplight dimmed for an instant.
translations.14: Elder Qin, it has been a while. I have come on the order of the Pavilion Master to collect three tenths of the spirit stones.
translations.15: Sanzheng? The spirit stones were painstakingly saved up by the sect. When would it ever be an outsider's turn to take them?
translations.16: The barrier has already cracked, so the spirit stones are not safe in your hands. I will return in three days.
translations.17: Jie Xuan let out a cold laugh, turned around, and walked away without looking back.
translations.18: When I say three days, it's three days; I never go back on my word.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard and glanced at Chou Shuang, who lay asleep on the couch.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough spirit stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me go guard the barrier. Miss Chou has Yuechuan looking after her, so I can be spared.
translations.21: Finally, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the Formation Eye Token. Only by holding it can you truly hold your Dao.
translations.23: Le Chuan tucked the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's arms and added a few more words of instruction in a low voice.
translations.24: At the mountain gate, Wan Qi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Brother Wan Qi. Miss Qiu has woken up, so please pass on my thanks to her.
translations.26: Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation-eye token close to his body.
translations.27: In the palace hall, Chou Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: Glad you're awake. You were unconscious for a whole day, so don't move around carelessly ▼
translations.29: Qiu Shuang struggled to sit up and gazed at the cracked sky outside the window.
translations.3: I brought three bags, all the best from the back mountain.
translations.30: Unbeknownst to anyone, the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal.
translations.4: The barrier cracked another seam last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep a wink.
translations.5: Before the words had even faded, Moqi Jing came racing up from the foot of the mountain.
translations.6: Panting, he said that a young woman was lying by the roadside at the foot of the mountain.
translations.7: Lift him up quickly. Ruoshui, go fetch the healing elixir.
translations.8: Wan Qi Jing rushed into the great hall carrying an unconscious woman on his back, the iron plate at his waist engraved with: Qiu Shuang.
translations.9: The wound isn't serious, it's just that spiritual energy is depleted. Feeding him one Spirit-Restoring Pill should be enough.
